name: Ruby on Rails
server: Puma 8.1 behind Thruster 0.1, as in the Dockerfile rails new generates
workers: Puma cluster mode: WEB_CONCURRENCY = BENCH_WORKERS (2) workers x 3 threads (the generated RAILS_MAX_THREADS default)
database_layer: Active Record (pg 1.7), pools of up to 8 connections per worker (16 in total); 6 in use, one per Puma thread (2 workers x 3 threads)
logging: Rails at warn (no request lines); Thruster's request log off

phase2.validation: Route constraint id: /\d+/ (404); Active Model form objects (ActiveModel::API with numericality and length validations) for the query string, the JSON body and the form: 422; malformed JSON 400

csrf.mechanism: protect_from_forgery (ActionController::Base default): token in the encrypted cookie session, masked authenticity_token field, Origin checked when present; InvalidAuthenticityToken, 422

session.mechanism: bin/rails generate authentication: a sessions row looked up through the signed session_id cookie, the user loaded through it; has_secure_password (bcrypt) on users.password_bcrypt

structure_note: Thruster (HTTP proxy) and Puma (2 workers x 3 threads) share the 2 vCPUs
notes: The rails new production setup; force_ssl stays commented out (no TLS) and db:prepare does not run at start-up.
